1662年：The Virginia Colony passed a law incorporating the principal of partus sequitur ventrem, ruling that children of enslaved mothers would be born into slavery, regardless of their father's race or status
1662年：Halfway Covenant adopted.

1663年：The Rhode Island Royal Charter provided recognition to the Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantation, and outlined many freedoms including freedom of religion and acknowledged Indian rights to the soil.
links: Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations

items.text: 1663年：King Charles II grants charter for a new colony, (Province of Carolina).
1663年：Gloucester County, Virginia Revolt

1664年：New Amsterdam captured by the English at the start of the Second Anglo-Dutch War. New Jersey and New York established as Proprietary Colonies of England. Royal Commission of 1664 sent to increase royal oversight of New England.
1665年：The Duke's Laws are issued.
1667年：New Netherland ceded to England under Treaty of Breda.
1667年：Virginia law enacted, declaring that baptism of slaves does not exempt them from bondage.
1668年：French found Sault Ste. Marie, Michigan
1669年：Virginia law enacted, that killing one's own enslaved people was not a felony.
1669年：The Fundamental Constitutions of Carolina are drawn up.
1669年－1670年：John Lederer of Virginia explores the Appalachian Mountains.
1670年：Charles Town (Charleston) founded in present-day South Carolina.
1671年：The Batts-Fallam expedition sponsored by Abraham Wood reaches the New River (West Virginia).
1672年：Blue Laws enacted in Connecticut.
1672年－73年：Louis Jolliet and Jacques Marquette explore the Illinois Country.
1674年：New Netherland permanently relinquished to English with Treaty of Westminster.
1675年：King Philip's War (1675–76) in New England.
1676年：Bacon's Rebellion in Virginia; Bacon writes the "Declaration of the People of Virginia".
links: Declaration of the People of Virginia

items.text: 1677年：Colonists in North Carolina rebel against Thomas Colepeper, 2nd Baron Colepeper. Edmund Andros, Governor of New York, negotiates the Covenant Chain with the Iroquois. Province of Maine absorbed by Massachusetts Bay Colony.

1679年：War between the Westo and colonial South Carolina results in the destruction of the Westo. The Province of New Hampshire is created out of the Massachusetts Bay Colony by royal decree from King Charles II.
1680年：Pueblo Revolt
1681年：William Penn receives a royal charter from Charles II to establish Pennsylvania.

1682年：René-Robert Cavelier, Sieur de La Salle explored the Ohio River Valley and the Mississippi River Valley, and he claimed the entire territory for France as far south as the Gulf of Mexico. William Penn publishes "Frame of Government of Pennsylvania" that provides for a precursor of a bicameral government. Philadelphia founded.
links: René-Robert Cavelier, Sieur de La Salle

items.text: 1685年：Charles II dies and his brother the Duke of York becomes King James II. Fort St. Louis (French colonization of Texas) established near Arenosa Creek on Matagorda Bay by French explorer Robert Cavelier de La Salle; the fort was abandoned in 1688.
1686年：Arkansas Post established by Henri de Tonti as the first European settlement in the lower Mississippi River Valley.
1688年：The first recorded formal protest against slavery, the 1688 Germantown Quaker Petition Against Slavery.
1688年－97年：King William's War, the North American theater of the Nine Years' War.
1688年：The Glorious Revolution occurs; King James II flees to France and is replaced by William and Mary of Orange.

1689年：The English Parliament presents the English Bill of Rights to William and Mary and is later used as one of the models for the United States Bill of Rights. The Boston Revolt and Leisler's Rebellion occurs. Toleration Act 1688 is passed by Parliament which gives limited freedom of religion to all English subject.
約1690年：Spanish authorities, concerned that France posed a competitive threat, constructed several missions in East Texas; see Spanish Missions in Texas.
1690年：The first newspaper issue in the English colonies is published in Boston, the Public Occurrences.
1692年：Salem Witch Trials.
1693年：College of William & Mary founded in Williamsburg, Virginia. Rice culture introduced in the Province of Carolina.
1694年：Mary II dies, William III takes sole rule over England.
1696年：Cahokia, Illinois established by French missionaries from Quebec and is one of the earliest permanent settlements in the region.
1697年：The Treaty of Ryswick ends King William's War and restores all colonial possessions to pre-war ownership.

1698年：The Parliament of England's Trade with Africa Act 1697 comes into effect, ending the Royal African Company's monopoly on English trade with Africa, including the Atlantic slave trade. The act, which was passed in part due to heavy pressure from merchants in England's American colonies, results in the number of Africans transported to the American colonies being increased from 5,000 to 45,000 per annum.

1699年：Capital of Virginia moved from Jamestown to Williamsburg; Jamestown is slowly abandoned. The Wool Act forbade the export of wool from the American colonies. Free blacks ordered to leave the Colony of Virginia.
1700年：José Romo de Vivar becomes one of the earliest European (Spanish) settlers in the future state of Arizona.

1701年：The Collegiate school at Saybrook is founded in Connecticut; it will later be renamed as Yale College. Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac founds Detroit for France. Delaware Colony granted charter, separating it from Pennsylvania.
1702年：William III dies, is succeeded by Queen Anne. Queen Anne's War (War of the Spanish Succession) begins. East Jersey and West Jersey become crown colonies. Mobile, Alabama founded.
1703年：Kaskaskia, Illinois established as a small mission station for the French.

1704年：The first regular newspaper publishes its initial edition in Boston, the News-Letter and was begun by John Campbell. The Province of Carolina allows the arming of the enslaved population during time of war.
1705年：The House of Burgesses passes the Virginia Slave Codes of 1705.
1706年：Benjamin Franklin born in Boston. Albuquerque founded and named for the viceroy of New Spain, Francisco Fernández de la Cueva, 10th Duke of Alburquerque.
links: Francisco Fernández de la Cueva, 10th Duke of Alburquerque

items.text: 1710年：Francis Nicholson takes Port Royal.
1711年－15年：North Carolina fights the Tuscarora War with the Tuscarora people.
1712年：New York Slave Revolt of 1712.
1713年：The Treaty of Utrecht is signed, bringing an end to Queen Anne's War; England gains Nova Scotia.
1714年：Queen Anne dies; succeeded by George I. Natchitoches established by Louis Juchereau de St. Denis, making it the oldest permanent European settlement in the modern state of Louisiana.
1715年：South Carolina begins the Yamasee War.

1718年：Mission San Antonio de Valero (The Alamo) built as the first Spanish mission along the San Antonio River. New Orleans founded by the French. Blackbeard is killed in battle by lieutenant Robert Maynard in the waters off the Province of North Carolina.
1720年：French construct Fort de Chartres, the oldest surviving building in Illinois.
1723年：The House of Burgesses passes an act to deal with slave rebellions. The French establish Fort Orleans along the Missouri River near Brunswick, Missouri.
1725年：Father Rale's War (1722–25)
1727年：George I dies, is succeeded by George II. British construct Fort Oswego.
1729年：Province of Carolina proprietors sell out to Crown. City of Baltimore founded.
約1730年：For the first time, the majority of the enslaved population in Chesapeake, Virginia were born in the Americas.
1732年：The Province of Georgia is founded by General James Oglethorpe. Where slavery was prohibited.
1735年：John Peter Zenger is found innocent of libel by the New York City trial on August 4.
1737年：Benjamin Lay writes All Slave-Keepers That Keep the Innocent in Bondage, Apostates. Published by Benjamin Franklin in Philadelphia.
1739年：The Stono Rebellion in the Province of South Carolina is crushed.
1739年－40年：George Whitefield begins his travels throughout the colonies. His message of everyday Christians having a personal connection with God resonates and begins the First Great Awakening.

1740年：The Plantation Act 1740 is passed to encourage immigration to the Thirteen Colonies and regularize the colonial naturalization procedures. Battle of Cartagena de Indias, where the colonists are called "Americans" for the first time. James Oglethorpe fails to take St. Augustine. South Carolina enacts the Negro Act of 1740.
1741年：The New York Conspiracy of 1741 is suppressed.
1743年：Russian Promyshlenniki begin exploring Alaska.
1744年：King George's War (1744–48).
1745年：New Englanders take Louisbourg.
1746年：Princeton University founded, with Jonathan Dickinson as its first president.
1747年：Founding of the Ohio Company.
1749年：Province of Georgia overturns its ban on slavery. Father Le Loutre's War (1749–55)
約1750年：Population of the Thirteen Colonies is roughly 1.5 million.
1750年：Thomas Walker passes through the Cumberland Gap.
1751年：The ban on slavery was lifted after 19 years in the Province of Georgia.
1752年：Benjamin Kent represented slaves in court against their masters in Massachusetts.

1754年：French and Indian War begins, which was a theater of the Seven Years' War; first engagement at the Battle of Jumonville Glen. Albany Congress, in which a "Union of Colonies" is proposed. Columbia University founded as King's College by George II Royal Charter.
1757年：Siege of Fort William Henry.
1758年：Siege of Louisbourg; Battle of Fort Frontenac; Battle of Fort Duquesne. The first black Baptist church is founded in Lunenburg, Virginia.
1759年：Quebec is taken, British victory assured in French and Indian War.
links: Battle of the Plains of Abraham

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1790–1819)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1790–1819)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1790–1819)

items.text: 1790年：Rhode Island ratifies the Constitution and becomes 13th state
1791年：The Bill of Rights, comprising the first ten amendments to the Constitution, is adopted.
1791年：First Bank of the United States chartered
links: First Bank of the United States

items.text: 1791年：Vermont becomes the 14th state (formerly the independent Vermont Republic)
1792年：Kentucky becomes the 15th state (formerly Kentucky County, Virginia)
1792年：1792 United States presidential election: George Washington reelected president, John Adams reelected vice president
1793年：Eli Whitney invents cotton gin
1793年3月4日：President Washington and Vice President Adams begin second terms
1793年：Yellow fever outbreak in Philadelphia
1793年：Fugitive Slave Act passed
1793年：Chisholm v. Georgia (2 US 419 1793) paves way for passage of 11th Amendment
links: Eleventh Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1794年：Whiskey Rebellion
1794年：Battle of Fallen Timbers
1795年：Treaty of Greenville
1795年：Jay's Treaty
1795年：11th Amendment "ratified by 12 of the then 15 states"
links: Eleventh Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1795年：Pinckney's Treaty (also called Treaty of San Lorenzo)
1796年：Tennessee becomes the 16th state (formerly part of North Carolina)
1796年：Treaty of Tripoli
1796年：1796 United States presidential election: John Adams is elected president, Thomas Jefferson vice president
1797年3月4日：John Adams becomes the second president, in Philadelphia; Thomas Jefferson becomes the second vice president
1798年：Alien and Sedition Acts
1798年：the Quasi-War starts
1798年：Charles Brockden Brown's novel Wieland published
1799年：Charles Brockden Brown's novel Edgar Huntly published
1799年：Fries's Rebellion
1799年：Logan Act
1799年：George Washington dies
1800年：Library of Congress founded
1800年：Convention of 1800 ends the Quasi-War
1800年：1800 United States presidential election: Thomas Jefferson and Aaron Burr tie in the Electoral College.
1801年：Thomas Jefferson elected president by the House of Representatives; Aaron Burr elected vice president.
1801年：President Adams appoints John Marshall Chief Justice
1801年3月4日：Jefferson becomes the third president; Burr becomes the third vice president
1803年：Marbury v. Madison (5 US 137 1803) allows Supreme Court to invalidate law passed by the United States Congress for first time: the Judiciary Act of 1789
1803年：Louisiana Purchase
1803年：Ohio, formerly part of Connecticut, becomes the 17th state
1804年：12th Amendment ratified
links: Twelfth Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1804年：New Jersey abolishes slavery
1804年：Burr–Hamilton duel (Alexander Hamilton dies)
1804年：Lewis and Clark set out
1804年：1804 United States presidential election: Thomas Jefferson reelected president; George Clinton elected vice president
1805年3月4日：President Jefferson begins second term; Clinton becomes the fourth vice president
1807年：Embargo Act of 1807
1807年：Robert Fulton invents steamboat
1807年：U.S. slave trade with Africa ends
1808年：1808 United States presidential election: James Madison elected president, George Clinton reelected vice president
1809年3月4日：Madison becomes the fourth president; Vice President Clinton begins second term
1809年：Non-Intercourse Act (March 1)
1810年：Fletcher v. Peck (10 US 87 1810) marks first time U.S. Supreme Court invalidates a state legislative act
1811年：First Bank of the United States charter expires
links: First Bank of the United States

items.text: 1812年4月20日：Vice President Clinton dies
1812年：War of 1812, an offshoot of the Napoleonic Wars, begins
1812年：Daniel Webster elected to the United States Congress
1812年：Louisiana becomes the 18th state
1812年：1812 United States presidential election: James Madison reelected president; Elbridge Gerry elected vice president
1813年3月4日：President Madison begins second term; Gerry becomes the fifth vice president
1813年－1814年：Creek War
1814年：British troops burn Washington, D.C., but are forced back at Baltimore
1814年11月23日：Vice President Gerry dies
1814年：Treaty of Ghent settles War of 1812
1815年：Battle of New Orleans
1816年：Indiana becomes the 19th state
1816年：Second Bank of the United States chartered
links: Second Bank of the United States

items.text: 1816年：1816 United States presidential election: James Monroe elected president, Daniel D. Tompkins vice president
1817年3月4日：Monroe becomes the fifth president; Tompkins becomes the sixth vice president
1817年：Rush-Bagot Treaty
1817年：Harvard Law School founded
1817年：Mississippi becomes the 20th state
1818年：Cumberland Road opened
1818年：Illinois becomes the 21st state
1818年：Jackson Purchase in Kentucky
1819年：Panic of 1819
1819年：Adams-Onís Treaty, including acquisition of Florida
1819年：McCulloch v. Maryland (17 US 316 1819) prohibits state laws from infringing upon federal constitutional authority
1819年：Dartmouth College v. Woodward (17 US 518 1819) protects principle of honoring contracts and charters
1819年：Alabama becomes the 22nd state in the U.S.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1820–1859)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1820–1859)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1820–1859)

items.text: 1820年：Massachusetts divided in two with the admission of Maine as a state.
1820年：1820 United States presidential election: James Monroe reelected president unopposed, Daniel D. Tompkins reelected vice president.
1821年3月4日：President Monroe and Vice President Tompkins begin their second terms
1821年：Missouri becomes a state
1821年：Florida becomes a U.S. territory; the 1819 Adams–Onís Treaty goes into effect
1823年：Monroe Doctrine proclaimed
1824年：Gibbons v. Ogden (22 US 1 1824) affirms federal over state authority in interstate commerce. Gibbons' business partner is Cornelius Vanderbilt.
1824年：1824 United States presidential election: Presidential results inconclusive. John C. Calhoun elected vice president.
1825年：John Quincy Adams elected president by the House of Representatives;
1825年3月4日：Adams becomes the sixth president; Calhoun becomes the seventh vice president
1825年：Erie Canal is finally completed
1826年：Former presidents Thomas Jefferson and John Adams die on the same day, which happens to be on the fiftieth anniversary of the approval of the Declaration of independence.
1828年：1828 United States presidential election: Andrew Jackson elected president; John C. Calhoun reelected vice president
1828年12月22日：First Lady-designate Rachel Jackson dies of a heart attack
1829年3月4日：Jackson becomes the seventh president; Vice President Calhoun begins second term
1830年－1839年：Second Great Awakening is the religious revival movement
1830年－1839年：Oregon Trail which comes into use by settlers migrating to the Pacific Northwest.
1830年：Indian Removal Act
1831年：Nat Turner's revolt
1831年：The Liberator begins publication in 1831
1831年：Cyrus McCormick invents the mechanical reaper
1831年：Petticoat affair (also known as the Eaton affair)
1832年：Worcester v. State of Georgia the Supreme Court rules in favor of Cherokees; President Jackson ignores the ruling.
1832年：Maria Stewart is the first black American woman to give a speech in front of a mixed audience.
1832年：Black Hawk War
1832年：Tariff of 1832
1832年：Ordinance of Nullification passed by South Carolina
1832年：Department of Indian Affairs established
1832年：1832 United States presidential election: Andrew Jackson reelected president; Martin Van Buren elected vice president.
1832年：Jackson vetoes the charter renewal of the Second Bank of the United States, bringing to a head the Bank War and ultimately leading to the Panic of 1837.
links: Second Bank of the United States

items.text: 1832年12月28日：Calhoun resigns as vice president.
1833年：The Force Bill expands presidential powers.
1833年3月4日：President Jackson begins second term; Van Buren becomes the eighth vice president.
1834年：Slavery debates at Lane Theological Seminary are one of the first major public discussions of the topic.
1835年：Alexis de Tocqueville's Democracy in America published.
1835年：Second Seminole War begins in Florida as members of the Seminole tribe resist relocation.
1836年：Creek War of 1836
1836年：Samuel Colt invents the revolver.
1836年：Original "gag rule" imposed when U.S. House of Representatives bars discussion of antislavery petitions.

1929年3月4日：Hoover becomes the 31st president and Curtis becomes the 31st vice president.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1930–1949)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1930–1949)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1930–1949)

items.text: 1930年：The Great Depression in the United States continues to worsen, reaching a nadir in early 1933.
links: Great Depression in the United States

items.text: 1930年：The Motion Picture Production Code becomes set of industry censorship guidelines governing production of the vast majority of United States motion pictures released by major studios; is effective for 38 years
1930年：Frozen vegetables, packaged by Clarence Birdseye, become the first frozen food to go on sale
1930年：The Democrats take Congress in the Midterms. Will keep it until 1946.
1930年：Hawley-Smoot Tariff
1930年：Clyde Tombaugh discovers Pluto
1930年：Sinclair Lewis is the first American to win Nobel Prize for Literature
1931年：Empire State Building opens in New York.
1931年：Japanese invasion of Manchuria, start of World War II in the Pacific.
1931年：The Whitney Museum of American Art opens to the public in New York City.
1931年：“The Star-Spangled Banner” becomes official U.S. national anthem
1931年：Hoover vetoes Veteran Bonus
1931年：Pearl Buck publishes The Good Earth making heroes of the Chinese peasants
1932年：Stimson Doctrine opposes Japanese expansion into Manchuria
1932年：Norris-La Guardia Act strengthens labor unions
1932年：Baby son of Charles Lindbergh was kidnapped and found dead
1932年：Bonus Army marches on DC; repressed by President Hoover
1932年：Reconstruction Finance Corporation finances relief
1932年：1932 United States presidential election: Franklin D. Roosevelt elected president, John Nance Garner elected vice president
1933年：Chicago Mayor Anton Cermak killed during a failed assassination attempt on President-elect Roosevelt by Giuseppe Zangara; the intended target was not wounded.
links: Attempted assassination of Franklin D. Roosevelt

items.text: 1933年：Over 12 million or 25% of Americans were unemployed
1933年：20th Amendment, establishing the beginning and ending of the terms of the elected federal offices.
links: Twentieth Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1933年3月4日：Roosevelt becomes the 32nd president. He is the last president to be inaugurated on March 4. It also began his "Hundred Days". Garner becomes the 32nd vice president. He is the last vice president to be inaugurated on March 4.
links: First 100 days of Franklin D. Roosevelt's presidency

items.text: 1933年：President Roosevelt establishes the New Deal, a response to the Great Depression, and focusing on what historians call the "3 Rs": relief, recovery and reform
1933年：Emergency Banking Act

1933年：Sweeping new programs proposed under President Roosevelt take effect: the Agricultural Adjustment Act, Civil Works Administration, Civilian Conservation Corps, Farm Credit Administration the Home Owners' Loan Corporation, the Tennessee Valley Authority, the Public Works Administration, the National Industrial Recovery Act
1933年：San Francisco Ballet founded
1933年：Frances Perkins appointed United States Secretary of Labor
1933年：21st Amendment, ending Prohibition
links: Twenty-first Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1933年：United States government recognizes the Soviet Union
1934年：Glass–Steagall Act
1934年：U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission established
1934年：Dust Bowl begins, causing major ecological and agricultural damage to the Great Plains states; severe drought, heat waves and other factors were contributors.
1934年：Federal Housing Administration
1934年：Johnson Act
1934年：Indian Reorganization Act
1934年：Philippine Commonwealth established
1934年：Reciprocal Trade Agreements Act
1934年：Tydings–McDuffie Act
1934年：John Dillinger killed
1934年：Share the Wealth society founded by Huey Long
1934年：The first federal prisoners arrived at Alcatraz
1935年：Works Progress Administration
1935年：The F.B.I. is established with J. Edgar Hoover as its first director.
1935年：Neutrality Act
1935年：Motor Carrier Act
1935年：Social Security Act
1935年：Schechter Poultry Corp. v. United States
links: Schechter Poultry Corp. v. United States

items.text: 1935年：National Labor Relations Act
1935年：Huey Long assassinated
1935年：Congress of Industrial Organizations formed
1935年：Alcoholics Anonymous founded
1935年：Revenue Act of 1935
1935年：Middletown is published
1936年：Robinson-Patman Act
1936年：Hoover Dam
1936年：Life magazine publishes first issue
1936年：United States v. Butler, which ruled that the processing taxes instituted under the 1933 Agricultural Adjustment Act were unconstitutional
1936年：Second London Naval Treaty
1936年：Jesse Owens won 4 gold medals at the Olympics in Berlin, Germany
1936年：1936 United States presidential election: Franklin D. Roosevelt reelected president, John Nance Garner reelected vice president
1936年：1936 Tupelo–Gainesville tornado outbreak
1936年：Babe Ruth and Ty Cobb named to baseball's Hall of Fame
links: National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum

items.text: 1937年：Look magazine publishes first issue
1937年：Neutrality Acts
1937年1月20日：President Roosevelt and Vice President Garner begin second terms.
1937年：Hindenburg disaster, killing 35 people and marking an end to airship travel
1937年：Panay incident, a Japanese attack on the United States Navy gunboat USS Panay while anchored in the Yangtze River outside of Nanjing
1937年：Golden Gate Bridge completed in San Francisco
1938年：Wheeler-Lea Act
1938年：Fair Labor Standards Act
1938年：Thornton Wilder’s play Our Town wins Pulitzer Prize
1938年：The comic book superhero Superman debuts in Action Comics #1 (June 1938)
1938年：Orson Welles' The War of the Worlds broadcast
links: The War of the Worlds (1938 radio drama)

items.text: 1939年：Hatch Act, aimed at corrupt political practices and prevented federal civil servants from campaigning
1939年：Nazi Germany invades Poland; World War II begins
1939年：Cash and carry proposed to replace the Neutrality Acts

1939年：President Roosevelt, appearing at the opening of the 1939 New York World's Fair, becomes the first president to give a speech that is broadcast on television. Semi-regular broadcasts air during the next two years
1940年：Selective Service Act, establishing the first peacetime draft in U.S. history
links: Selective Training and Service Act of 1940

items.text: 1940年：Alien Registration (Smith) Act
1940年：Oldsmobile becomes the first car maker to offer a fully automatic transmission
1940年：Bugs Bunny, Tom and Jerry and Woody Woodpecker make their cartoon debuts
1940年：Billboard magazine publishes its first music popularity chart, the predecessor to today's Hot 100
1940年：1940 United States presidential election: Franklin D. Roosevelt is reelected president to a record third term, Henry A. Wallace is elected vice president
1940年：Color television is demonstrated by the Columbia Broadcasting System
1941年：Regular commercial television broadcasting begins; CBS and NBC television networks launched.
1941年1月20日：President Roosevelt begins third term; Wallace becomes the 33rd vice president
1941年3月：Lend-Lease, which supplies the United Kingdom, the Soviet Union, China, France and other Allied nations with vast amounts of war material during World War II
1941年6月22日：Operation Barbarossa: Nazi Germany begins war against the Soviet Union
1941年8月：Atlantic Charter, drafted by the UK and U.S., to serve as the blueprint for the postwar world after World War II
1941年12月7日：Attack on Pearl Harbor; U.S. enters World War II by declaring war on Japan the next day; and three days later against Germany and against Italy.
links: United States declaration of war on Japan
United States declaration of war on Germany (1941)
United States declaration of war on Italy

items.text: 1942年：Japanese American internment, German American Internment, and Italian American Internment begin, per executive order by President Roosevelt; the order also authorizes the seizure of their property.
1942年－1945年：Automobile production in the United States for private consumers halted.
1942年：Casablanca released
1942年：Sugar and gasoline are rationed
1942年3月：Congress of Racial Equality founded
1942年：U.S.-controlled Commonwealth of the Philippines conquered by Japanese forces
1942年4月：Doolittle Raid
1942年5月：Battle of the Coral Sea
1942年6月：Battle of Midway
1942年8月：Guadalcanal campaign begins
1942年8月：Office of Price Administration founded
1942年：Revenue Act of 1942
1942年11月：Operation Torch
1942年：Cocoanut Grove fire kills 492 people, leads to vast reforms in fire codes and safety standards
1943年：Oklahoma! the first musical written by the team of composer Richard Rodgers and librettist Oscar Hammerstein II opens on Broadway
1943年：Detroit, Michigan race riots
1943年：Allied invasion of Sicily
1943年9月：Allied invasion of Italy begins
1943年：Cairo Conference
1943年：Casablanca Conference
1943年：Tehran Conference (meeting between the leaders of USSR, UK, and US (Stalin, Churchill and Roosevelt) to discuss D-day)
1944年：Battle of Monte Cassino
1944年：Dumbarton Oaks Conference
1944年：G.I. Bill
1944年6月6日：D-Day. Operation Overlord begins.
1944年7月：Bretton Woods Conference
links: United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference

items.text: 1944年8月：battle of the Falaise pocket. It opens the way to the Liberation of Paris and the Franco-German border
1944年：Battle of Peleliu
1944年：Battle of Leyte
1944年：1944 United States presidential election: Franklin D. Roosevelt reelection for a fourth term, becomes the only U.S. president elected four times. Harry S. Truman is elected vice president
1944年12月：the Wehrmacht begins the Battle of the Bulge
1945年1月20日：President Roosevelt begins fourth term; Truman becomes the 34th vice president
1945年2月：Yalta Conference
1945年：Battle of Iwo Jima
1945年：Battle of Okinawa
1945年：due to inflation and working conditions, nationwide labor strikes begin.
1945年4月12日：President Roosevelt dies, Vice President Truman becomes the 33rd US president
1945年5月8日：Germany surrenders, end of World War II in Europe
links: End of World War II in Europe

items.text: 1945年：Carousel opens on Broadway
1945年7月：Potsdam Conference
1945年：Tennessee Williams’s play The Glass Menagerie opens in New York
1945年8月15日：Surrender of Japan (formally signed on 2 September 1945, ending the war)
links: End of World War II in Asia

items.text: 1945年：United Nations Conference on International Organization; United Nations established
links: United Nations Conference on International Organization

items.text: 1945年6月：United Nations Charter signed in San Francisco, establishing the United Nations; it replaces the League of Nations
1945年－1949年：Nuremberg Trials and Subsequent Nuremberg Trials
1946年3月：Churchill's Iron Curtain speech
1946年：Benjamin Spock's The Common Sense Book of Baby and Child Care published
links: The Common Sense Book of Baby and Child Care

items.text: 1946年：Employment Act
1946年：United States Atomic Energy Act of 1946
links: United States Atomic Energy Act of 1946

items.text: 1946年：President's Committee on Civil Rights
1946年：Philippines regain independence from the U.S.
1946年11月：Republicans win the US House of Representatives elections for the first time in 16 years.
links: 1946 United States House of Representatives elections

items.text: 1947年3月：Federal Employee Loyalty Program
1947年：Presidential Succession Act
1947年5月：Office of Price Administration dissolved
1947年：Taft Hartley Act
1947年：U.F.O. crash at Roswell, New Mexico
1947年：National Security Act of 1947
1947年：General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)
links: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

items.text: 1947年：Marshall Plan drafted
1947年：Polaroid camera invented
1947年：Truman Doctrine establishes "the policy of the United States to support free peoples who are resisting attempted subjugation by armed minorities or by outside pressures"
1947年：Jackie Robinson breaks color barrier in baseball
1947年：Studebaker becomes the first automobile manufacturer to introduce a "post-war" model; most automakers wait until 1948 or 1949
1947年：Jackson Pollock begins painting his most famous series of paintings called the drip paintings in Easthampton, New York
1947年：First broadcast of Meet the Press
1947年：World Series is broadcast live on television for the first time
1948年：The Texaco Star Theater, starring Milton Berle, becomes the first major successful U.S. television program; The Toast of the Town also debuts
1948年：Berlin Blockade
1948年：1948 United States presidential election: Harry S. Truman is elected president for a full term, Alben W. Barkley is elected vice president
1948年：Truman desegregates armed forces
1948年：Selective Service Act of 1948: Passed after first such act expired
1948年：Organization of American States: Alliance of North America and South America
1948年：Alger Hiss Case
1949年1月20日：President Truman begins full term, Barkley becomes the 35th vice president
1949年：North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) formed
1949年：The first mammal, a rhesus monkey named Albert II, is launched into space in a suborbital flight
1949年：In China, Communists under Mao Zedong force Chiang Kai-shek's KMT government to retreat to Taiwan
1949年：Soviet Union tests its first atomic bomb
1949年：Department of War becomes the Department of the Army and becomes subordinate to the new Department of Defense
1949年：Germany divided into East and West
1949年：Truman attempts to continue FDR's legacy with his Fair Deal, but most acts don't pass

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1950–1969)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1950–1969)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1950–1969)

items.text: 1950年：Senator Joseph McCarthy gains power, and McCarthyism (1950–1954) begins
1950年：McCarran Internal Security Act
1950年：Korean War begins
1950年：The comic strip Peanuts, by Charles M. Schulz, is first published
1950年：NBC airs Broadway Open House a late-night comedy, variety, talk show through 1951. Hosted by Morey Amsterdam and Jerry Lester and Dagmar, it serves as the prototype for The Tonight Show
1950年：Failed assassination attempt by two Puerto Rican nationals on President Harry S. Truman while he was living at Blair House.
links: Attempted assassination of Harry S. Truman

items.text: 1951年：22nd Amendment, establishing term limits for president.
links: Twenty-second Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1951年：Mutual Security Act
1951年：General Douglas MacArthur fired by President Truman for comments about using nuclear weapons on China

1951年：The first live transcontinental television broadcast takes place in San Francisco, California from the Japanese Peace Treaty Conference. One month later, the situation comedy I Love Lucy premieres on CBS, sparking the rise of television in the American home and the Golden Age of Television.
1951年：See It Now, an American newsmagazine and documentary series broadcast by CBS from 1951 to 1958. It was created by Edward R. Murrow and Fred W. Friendly, Murrow being the host of the show.
1951年：The Catcher in the Rye is published by J. D. Salinger and invigorates the rebellious youth of the period, eventually earning the title of a Classic with its profound impact.
1952年：The debut of the Today show on NBC, originally hosted by Dave Garroway is the fourth longest running talk show on television.
links: List of longest-running United States television series

items.text: 1952年：ANZUS Treaty enters into force
1952年：Immigration and Nationality Act
1952年：1952 United States presidential election: Dwight D. Eisenhower elected as president, Richard Nixon elected as vice president
1953年1月20日：Eisenhower becomes the 34th president and Nixon becomes the 36th vice president
1953年：Rosenbergs executed
1953年：Korean Armistice Agreement
1953年：Shah of Iran returns to power in CIA-orchestrated coup known as Operation Ajax
1954年：The Tournament of Roses Parade becomes the first event nationally televised in color
1954年：Four Puerto Rican nationalists attack the House of Representatives, wounding 5 members

1954年：Detonation of Castle Bravo, a 15 megaton Hydrogen bomb on Bikini Atoll. 1,000 times more powerful than the Hiroshima and Nagasaki weapons, it vaporized three islands, displaced the islanders and caused long lasting contamination
1954年：Joseph McCarthy discredited in Army-McCarthy hearings
1954年：Censure or formal disapproval on Senator Joseph McCarthy after the Army-McCarthy hearings. He died three years later in 1957.
1954年：President Eisenhower proposes the Domino theory: If South Vietnam fell to communism, so too would all nations of Southeast Asia, and eventually worldwide.
1954年：First Indochina War ends after the U.S. kept sending aid to the French. France was defeated by Ho Chi Minh and his army at the Battle of Dien Bien Phu.
1954年：The CIA overthrows Guatemala's president Jacobo Arbenz Guzmán (Operation PBSuccess)

1954年：Saint Lawrence Seaway Act, permitting the construction of the system of locks, canals and channels that permits ocean-going vessels to travel from the Atlantic Ocean to the North American Great Lakes, is approved

1954年：Brown v. Board of Education, a landmark decision of the Supreme Court, declares state laws establishing separate public schools for black and white students and denying black children equal educational opportunities unconstitutional
1954年：The U.S. becomes a member of the Southeast Asia Treaty Organization (or SEATO) alliance
1954年：Geneva Conference. U.S. rejects the French decision to recognize Communist control of North Vietnam. U.S. increases aid to South Vietnam.
1954年：The People's Republic of China lays siege on Quemoy and Matsu Islands; Eisenhower sends in Navy to demonstrate an invasion of Taiwan would not be permitted
1954年：The Dow Jones Industrial Average closes at an all-time high of 382.74, the first time the Dow has surpassed its peak level reached just before the Wall Street Crash of 1929
1954年：NBC airs The Tonight Show, the first late-night talk show, originally hosted by Steve Allen
1954年：The Democrats retake both houses of Congress in the Midterms. Will keep the Senate until 1981 and the House until 1994.
1955年：Ray Kroc opens a McDonald's fast food restaurant and, after purchasing the franchise from its original owners, oversees its national (and later, worldwide) expansion
1955年：Murder of Emmett Till
1955年：Rosa Parks remains seated on a bus, the incident which evolves into the Montgomery bus boycott
1955年：AFL and CIO merge in America's largest labor union federation
1955年：Warsaw Pact, which establishes a mutual defense treaty subscribed to by eight communist states in Eastern Europe (including the USSR)
1955年：Disneyland opens at Anaheim, California
1955年：Jonas Salk develops polio vaccine

1955年：Rock and roll music enters the mainstream, with "Rock Around the Clock" by Bill Haley & His Comets becoming the first record to top the Billboard pop charts. Elvis Presley also begins his rise to fame around this same time.
1955年：Actor James Dean is killed in a highway accident
1956年：The controversial 1956 Sugar Bowl takes place. Georgia's pro segregationist governor publicly threatens Georgia' Tech's president to not allow the game to take place, as students riot.
1956年：President Eisenhower secures passages of Interstate Highway Act, which will construct 41,000 miles (66,000 km) of the Interstate Highway System over a 20-year period
1956年：The U.S. refuses to provide military support the Hungarian Revolution
1956年：Elvis Presley appears on The Ed Sullivan Show for the first time.
1956年：Marilyn Monroe marries playwright Arthur Miller.
1956年：Jackson Pollock dies in a car crash
1956年：1956 United States presidential election: Dwight D. Eisenhower is reelected president, Richard Nixon reelected vice president
1956年："In God We Trust" adopted as national motto
1957年1月20日：President Eisenhower and Vice President Nixon begin second terms
1957年：Eisenhower Doctrine, wherein a country could request American economic assistance and/or aid from military forces if it was being threatened by armed aggression from another state
1957年：Civil Rights Act of 1957, primarily a voting rights bill, becomes the first civil rights legislation enacted by Congress since Reconstruction
1957年：Soviets launch Sputnik; "space race" begins
1957年：Shippingport Atomic Power Station, the first commercial nuclear power plant in the U.S., goes into service
1957年：Little Rock, Arkansas school desegregation. Eisenhower recruits the U.S. National Guard to escort the Little Rock Nine
1958年：National Defense Education Act
1958年：The Affluent Society written by John Galbraith
1958年：NASA formed as the U.S. begins ramping up efforts to explore space
1958年：Jack Kilby invents the integrated circuit
1959年：The NBC western Bonanza becomes the first drama to be broadcast in color
1959年：Cuban Revolution
1959年：Landrum–Griffin Act, a labor law that regulates labor unions' internal affairs and their officials' relationships with employers, becomes law
1959年：Alaska and Hawaii became the 49th and 50th U.S. states; as of January 2025[update], they are the final two states admitted to the union.
1959年：Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper are killed in Clear Lake, Iowa in a plane crash.
1960年：U-2 incident, wherein a CIA U-2 spy plane was shot down while flying a reconnaissance mission over Soviet Union airspace

1960年：Greensboro sit-ins, sparked by four African American college students refusing to move from a segregated lunch counter, and the Nashville sit-ins, spur similar actions and increases sentiment in the Civil Rights Movement.
1960年：Author Harper Lee publishes To Kill A Mockingbird
1960年：Civil Rights Act of 1960, establishing federal inspection of local voter registration polls and penalties for those attempting to obstruct someone's attempt to register to vote or actually vote
1960年：National Front for the Liberation of Vietnam formed
links: National Front for the Liberation of Vietnam

items.text: 1960年：John Fitzgerald Kennedy defeats vice president under the Eisenhower administration, Republican Richard Milhous Nixon. The campaign included the first televised United States presidential debate.
1960年：1960 United States presidential election: John F. Kennedy elected president, Lyndon B. Johnson elected vice president
1961年：US breaks diplomatic relations with Cuba
1961年：Eisenhower gives celebrated "military–industrial complex" farewell address
1961年1月20日：Kennedy becomes the 35th president, Johnson becomes the 37th vice president
1961年：23rd Amendment, which grants electors to the District of Columbia
links: Twenty-third Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1961年：Peace Corps established
1961年：Alliance for Progress
1961年：Bay of Pigs Invasion
1961年：Alan Shepard pilots the Freedom 7 capsule to become the first American in space
1961年：Trade embargo on Cuba
1961年：Berlin Crisis of 1961
1961年：Vietnam War officially begins with 900 military advisors landing in Saigon
1961年：OPEC (The Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries) formed
1962年：Trade Expansion Act
1962年：Andy Warhol becomes famous for his Campbell's Soup Cans painting
1962年：John Glenn orbits the Earth in Friendship 7, becoming the first American to do so
1962年：Cuban Missile Crisis, the closest nuclear confrontation involving the U.S. and USSR
1962年：Baker v. Carr, enabling federal courts to intervene in and to decide reapportionment cases
1962年：Engel v. Vitale, determines that it is unconstitutional for state officials to compose an official school prayer and require its recitation in public schools
1962年：Students for a Democratic Society (SDS)
links: Students for a Democratic Society (1960 organization)

items.text: 1962年：The comic-book superhero Spider-Man debuts in Amazing Fantasy #15 (August 1962) by Marvel Comics
1962年：Marilyn Monroe dies of apparent acute barbiturate poisoning at 36
1963年：Bob Dylan and Columbia Records release The Freewheelin' Bob Dylan (his second studio album), which becomes a classic
1963年：Civil rights activist Medgar Evers assassinated outside his home by Byron De La Beckwith
1963年：Atomic Test Ban Treaty
1963年：The Birmingham campaign and its Children's Crusade focus attention on the civil rights movement
1963年：March on Washington; Martin Luther King Jr. "I Have a Dream" speech
1963年：The Feminine Mystique by Betty Friedan published, sparking the women's liberation movement
1963年：Community Mental Health Act signed by Kennedy
1963年11月22日：President Kennedy assassinated in Dallas; Vice President Johnson becomes the 36th president.

1963年：The man accused of assassinating President Kennedy, Lee Harvey Oswald, is shot and killed by Dallas nightclub owner Jack Ruby. The assassination marks the first 24-hour coverage of a major news event by the major networks.
1964年：Ghetto riots (1964–1969), beginning with the Harlem riot of 1964

1964年：The Beatles arrive in the U.S., and subsequent appearances on The Ed Sullivan Show, mark the start of the British Invasion (or, an increased number of rock and pop performers from the United Kingdom who became popular around the world, including the U.S.)
1964年：Tonkin Gulf incident; Gulf of Tonkin Resolution
1964年：24th Amendment, prohibiting both Congress and the states from conditioning the right to vote in federal elections on payment of a poll tax or other types of tax
links: Twenty-fourth Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1964年：President Johnson proposes the Great Society, whose social reforms were aimed at the elimination of poverty and racial injustice. New major spending programs that addressed education, medical care, urban problems, and transportation were launched later in the 1960s.
1964年：Economic Opportunity Act
1964年：Civil Rights Act of 1964, outlawing legalized discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, and national origin and ended legalized racial segregation in the United States
links: Racial segregation in the United States

items.text: 1964年：Panama Canal Zone riots
1964年：The Ford Mustang is introduced
1964年：In the election, President Johnson won by one of the largest victories in U.S. history, defeating Arizona Republican Senator Barry Goldwater
1964年：1964 United States presidential election: Johnson elected president for a full term, Hubert H. Humphrey elected vice president
1965年1月20日：President Johnson begins full term, Humphrey becomes the 38th vice president
1965年：President Johnson escalates the United States military involvement in the Vietnam War

1965年：Students for a Democratic Society (SDS) and the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (SNCC), a civil rights activist group, led the first of several anti-war marches in Washington, D.C., with about 25,000 protesters
1965年：President Johnson appoints Thurgood Marshall as the first African-American Supreme Court Justice
1965年：The Selma to Montgomery marches bring attention to the civil rights movement's call for voting rights
1965年：Immigration Act of 1965
1965年：Voting Rights Act
1965年：Medicaid and Medicare enacted
1965年：Higher Education Act of 1965
1965年：Malcolm X, an African-American Muslim minister, public speaker, and human rights activist is assassinated in Harlem, New York
1965年：The Watts riots in the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, lasts six days and is the first of several major urban riots due to racial issues.
1966年：Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) established
links: United States Department of Housing and Urban Development

items.text: 1966年：Department of Transportation created
1966年：National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act
links: National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act

items.text: 1966年：Miranda v. Arizona established "Miranda rights" for suspects
1966年：Feminist group National Organization for Women (NOW) formed
1966年：The three major American television networks—NBC, CBS and ABC—have full color lineups in their prime-time schedules.

1966年：Heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali (formerly known as Cassius Clay) declared himself a conscientious objector and refused to go to war. In 1967 Ali was sentenced to five years in prison for draft evasion, but his conviction was later overturned on appeal. In addition, he was stripped of his title and banned from professional boxing for more than three years.

1967年：Jack Ruby died of a pulmonary embolism, secondary to bronchogenic carcinoma (lung cancer), on January 3, 1967, at Parkland Hospital, where Oswald had died and where President Kennedy had been pronounced dead after his assassination.
1967年：The first Super Bowl is played, with the Green Bay Packers defeating the Kansas City Chiefs 35–10.
1967年：Detroit race riot precipitates the "Long Hot Summer of 1967", when race riots erupt in 159 cities nationwide.
1967年：The Outsiders published by S.E. Hinton
1967年：Glassboro Summit Conference between U.S. president Lyndon Johnson and Soviet Premier Alexei Kosygin
1967年：The "Summer of Love" embodies the growing counterculture, with the Monterey Pop Festival and Scott McKenzie's "San Francisco (Be Sure to Wear Flowers in Your Hair)" among the highlights.
links: San Francisco (Be Sure to Wear Flowers in Your Hair)

items.text: 1967年：25th Amendment establishes succession to the presidency and procedures for filling a vacancy in the office of the vice president
links: Twenty-fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1967年：American Samoa becomes self-governing under a new constitution

1968年：On March 31, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson announces to the nation on television that he will not seek re-election. Opposition toward him and the Democratic Party was growing. The escalation of Vietnam was one of these issues.
1968年：Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
links: Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.

items.text: 1968年：The National Front for the Liberation of Vietnam launches the Tet Offensive
links: National Front for the Liberation of Vietnam

items.text: 1968年：Civil Rights Act of 1968, commonly known as the Fair Housing Act

1968年：A New York Senator and a leading 1968 Democratic presidential candidate, Robert F. Kennedy, is assassinated in Los Angeles after winning the California primary for the Democratic Party's nomination for president, by Sirhan Sirhan.
1968年：Police clashes with anti-war protesters in Chicago during the 1968 Democratic National Convention
1968年：U.S. signs Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty
1968年：1968 United States presidential election: Richard Nixon elected president, Spiro T. Agnew elected vice president; Shirley Chisholm becomes first black woman elected to U.S. Congress
1968年：East L.A. walkouts, or Chicano Blowouts
1968年：Apollo 8 and its three-astronaut crew orbit the Moon, Earthrise photograph taken
1968年：Music group Simon and Garfunkel release "Mrs. Robinson" from their album The Graduate.
1968年：President Johnson awards medals of honor to soldiers from Vietnam.
1969年1月20日：Nixon becomes the 37th president, Agnew becomes the 39th vice president
1969年："Vietnamization" begins
1969年：Author Maya Angelou publishes I Know Why The Caged Bird Sings
links: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings

items.text: 1969年：Stonewall riots in New York City marks the start of the modern gay rights movement in the U.S.
1969年：Chappaquiddick incident, where Sen. Edward M. Kennedy drives off a bridge on his way home from a party on Chappaquiddick Island, Massachusetts, killing his passenger, Mary Jo Kopechne
1969年：Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the Moon on the Apollo 11 mission
1969年：The Woodstock Festival in White Lake, New York, becomes an enormously successful musical and cultural gathering; a milestone for the baby-boom generation
links: White Lake, Sullivan County, New York

items.text: 1969年：Warren E. Burger appointed Chief Justice of the United States to replace Earl Warren
links: Chief Justice of the United States

items.text: 1969年：U.S. bombs North Vietnamese positions in Cambodia and Laos
1969年：Sesame Street premieres on National Educational Television.
1969年：Secret peace talks with Vietnam begin
1969年：Although 100-1 shots at the beginning of the season, the New York Mets win the World Series.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1970–1989)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1970–1989)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1970–1989)

items.text: 1970年：The first Earth Day is observed.
1970年：Kent State and Jackson State shootings occur during student protests which grew violent. National Guard troops and police kill six students, wound others.
1970年：American Top 40, hosted by radio personality Casey Kasem, becomes the first successful nationally syndicated radio program featuring a weekly countdown.
1970年：The Public Broadcasting System (PBS) begins operations, succeeding National Educational Television (NET).
1970年：Singer-songwriter-guitarist-musician Jimi Hendrix dies of a drug overdose at the age 27.
1970年：Singer Janis Joplin dies of a drug overdose at the age of 27.
1970年：The Environmental Protection Agency is created.
1970年：The Occupational Safety and Health Act, or OSHA, is signed into law.
1971年：Singer Jim Morrison dies of a drug overdose at the age of 27.
1971年：President Richard Nixon ends the United States Gold standard monetary policy, known as the Nixon Shock
1971年：A ban on radio and television cigarette advertisements goes into effect in the United States
1971年：The landmark situation comedy, All in the Family, premieres on CBS.
1971年：The 26th Amendment is ratified, allowing 18-year-olds to vote.
links: Twenty-sixth Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1971年：In New York Times Co. v. United States, the Supreme Court rules that the Pentagon Papers may be published, rejecting government injunctions as unconstitutional prior restraint.
links: New York Times Co. v. United States

items.text: 1972年：President Richard Nixon visits Mao Zedong in China, an astonishing step in formally normalizing relations between the United States and China.
1972年：The Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty is signed with the USSR.
1972年：First African-American major league baseball player Jackie Robinson dies.
1972年：Watergate scandal: Five men arrested for the burglary of the Democratic National Committee headquarters at the Watergate office complex in Washington, D.C.
1972年：1972 United States presidential election: Richard M. Nixon re-elected president, Spiro T. Agnew re-elected vice president
1972年：Apollo 17 flies and lands to the Moon, and becomes the last crewed mission there (as of May 2025)(Artemis III will launch in mid-2027 with the next crewed landing on the Moon).
1973年1月20日：President Nixon and Vice President Agnew begin second terms.
1973年：Former president Lyndon B. Johnson dies in Stonewall, Texas, of his third and final heart attack. It was at the LBJ ranch.
1973年：State funeral of President Lyndon Johnson
1973年：Roe v. Wade Supreme Court ruling overturns state laws against abortion.
links: Supreme Court of the United States

items.text: 1973年：The Paris Peace Accords ends direct U.S. involvement in the Vietnam War.
1973年：The Senate Watergate hearings begin, highlighted by Fred Thompson's discovery of Nixon's secret tapes.
1973年：Skylab is launched as the USA's first space station.
1973年10月10日：Vice President Agnew resigns in disgrace as part of a plea bargain.
1973年12月6日：Gerald R. Ford becomes the first person to be appointed vice president under the 25th Amendment to the Constitution.
links: Twenty-fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution

items.text: 1973年：Watergate scandal: President Nixon fires two attorneys general, and their appointed acting attorney general replacement fires the Watergate Special Prosecutor over disposition of the secret tapes.

1973年－1974年：The United States is affected by the Arab Oil Embargo; gasoline prices skyrocket as supplies of gasoline and heating oil are in short supply. In response, daylight saving time is started in January (nearly four months earlier than usual), and the national speed limit is lowered to 55 mph.
1974年：The 1974 Super Outbreak, the second-largest series of tornadoes in history (at 148), hits 13 U.S. states and one Canadian province; 315 people are killed and more than 5,000 are injured.
1974年：Hank Aaron of the Atlanta Braves breaks Babe Ruth's home run record by hitting his 715th career home run.
1974年：Watergate scandal: The House Judiciary Committee votes to impeach President Nixon
1974年："Sweet Home Alabama" released by Lynyrd Skynyrd.
1974年8月9日：President Nixon resigns, becoming the first and only U.S. president to step down. Vice President Ford becomes the 38th president.
1974年12月19日：Nelson A. Rockefeller becomes the second person to be appointed vice president under the 25th Amendment to the Constitution.
1974年：Watergate scandal: Ford pardons Nixon for any crimes he may have committed against the United States while president, believing it to be in the "best interests of the country."
1974年：Restrictions are removed on holding private gold within the United States.
1975年：President Ford signs The Helsinki Accords.
1975年：The movie Jaws is released. It is a landmark in Steven Spielberg's movie career.
1975年：Construction of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System begins.
1975年：The Vietnam War ends.
1975年：Fall of Saigon
1975年：Bill Gates founds Microsoft, which will eventually dominate the home computer operating system market.
1975年：The Apollo–Soyuz Test Project begins, where an American Apollo spacecraft and a Soviet Soyuz spacecraft dock in orbit, marking the first such link-up between spacecraft from the two nations.
1975年：President Ford survives two assassination attempts in a 17-day span (in Sacramento and in San Francisco).
links: Attempted assassination of Gerald Ford in Sacramento
Attempted assassination of Gerald Ford in San Francisco

items.text: 1975年：The television series Wheel of Fortune and Saturday Night Live premiere on NBC.
1975年：Sony's Betamax becomes the first commercially successful home video recording unit.
1976年：The Copyright Act of 1976 makes sweeping changes to United States copyright law.
1976年：Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne found Apple Inc.
1976年：Americans celebrate the Bicentennial of the United States.
1976年：1976 United States presidential election: Jimmy Carter is elected president, Walter Mondale is elected vice president.
1977年1月20日：Carter becomes the 39th president, Mondale becomes the 42nd vice president
1977年：The first home personal computer, the Commodore PET, is released for retail sale.
1977年：The television miniseries Roots airs on ABC, to critical acclaim and record audiences.
1977年：The science-fiction space opera film Star Wars debuts in theaters.
1977年：The New York City blackout of 1977 lasts for 25 hours, resulting in looting and other disorder.
1977年：Elvis Presley, the king of rock and roll, dies in his home in Graceland at age 42. 75,000 fans line the streets of Memphis for his funeral
1977年：The Atari 2600 becomes the first successful home video game system, popularizing the use of microprocessor-based hardware and cartridges containing game code.
1977年：The International Women’s Year Conference (IWY), is held in Houston, Texas, where 2,000 state-appointed delegates vote on planks to form a “Plan of Action” called “What Women Want.”
1978年：Volkswagen becomes the second non-American automobile manufacturer (after Rolls-Royce) to open a plant in the United States, commencing production of the Rabbit.
1978年：The Camp David Accords commence, where Prime Minister Menachem Begin (Israel) and President Anwar Sadat (Egypt) begin the peace process at Camp David, Maryland.

1978年：The Humphrey Hawkins Full Employment Act is signed into law, adjusting the government's economic goals to include full employment, growth in production, price stability, and a balance of trade and budget.
1978年：The Senate votes to turn the Panama Canal over to Panamanian control on December 31, 1999.
1978年：Supervisor Harvey Milk and Mayor George Moscone are assassinated by Dan White in San Francisco on November 27.
1979年：The Three Mile Island nuclear accident occurs, America's most catastrophic nuclear power plant accident in its history.
1979年：The Iran hostage crisis begins. In the aftermath, a second energy crisis develops, tripling the price of oil and sending U. S. gasoline prices over $1 per gallon for the first time.

1979年：American Airlines Flight 191 crashes after takeoff from O'Hare International Airport, killing all 271 aboard and two on the ground, making it one of the deadliest aviation incidents on U.S. soil.
1979年：Facing bankruptcy, Chrysler receives government loan guarantees upon the request of CEO Lee Iacocca to help revive the company.
1979年：The Sugarhill Gang releases Rapper's Delight, widely considered the first major hip hop song. The hip hop music movement occurred in the Early 1970s, but would evolve over time.

1980年：The United States boycotts the Summer Olympics in Moscow to protest the 1979 Soviet invasion of Afghanistan; also announces a grain embargo against the Soviet Union with the support of the European Commission.
1980年：The Refugee Act of 1980 is signed into law, reforming United States immigration law and admitted refugees on systematic basis for humanitarian reasons
1980年：The Mount St. Helens eruption in Washington on May 18 kills 57.
1980年：1980 United States presidential election: Ronald Reagan is elected president, with George H. W. Bush elected vice president
1980年：Former Beatle John Lennon is murdered by a gunman on December 8 in New York City.
1981年1月20日：Reagan becomes the 40th president; Bush becomes the 43rd vice president. On the same day Iran releases hostages, marking the end of the Iran hostage crisis.
1981年3月30日：Attempted assassination of President Reagan by John Hinckley Jr.
1981年－1982年：United States is part of the global recession, with national unemployment as high as 9%, with some areas much higher, and inflation as high as 13.5%. Early 1980s recession
links: Early 1980s recession in the United States

items.text: 1981年：Kemp-Roth Tax Cut
1981年：MTV signs on, becoming the first 24-hour cable network dedicated to airing music videos.
1981年：A hotel walkway collapses in Kansas City, Missouri, killing 114 and injuring over 200; it was the deadliest structural collapse to occur in the United States until 9/11.
1981年：The Space Shuttle Columbia is launched, marking America's first return to space since 1975.
1981年：Sandra Day O'Connor becomes the first woman on the U.S. Supreme Court.
1981年：In August, President Reagan fires 11,345 striking air traffic controllers. Professional Air Traffic Controllers Organization (1968)

1981年－1982年：The killing of 6-year-old Adam Walsh (1981), and the disappearance of Johnny Gosch, a 12-year-old newspaper carrier from Des Moines, Iowa (1982), raise awareness of missing children cases in the United States.
1983年：241 U.S. Marines are killed by a suicide bomb in Lebanon.
1983年：The United States invades Grenada.
1983年：Singer Karen Carpenter dies from complications of anorexia nervosa, raising awareness of eating disorders.
1983年：Chrysler unveils its minivans — the Dodge Caravan and Plymouth Voyager (as 1984 models) — to the public.
1983年：The Reagan Administration creates the Strategic Defense Initiative, nicknamed Star Wars, to block nuclear missile attacks.
1984年：Most of the Eastern Bloc boycotts the Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
1984年：1984 United States presidential election: Ronald Reagan is re-elected president, with George H. W. Bush re-elected as vice president.
1984年：The drug problem intensifies as crack (a smokable form of cocaine) is first introduced into the Los Angeles area.
1984年：Awareness of child sexual abuse by pedophiles raised through high-profile media coverage on programs such as 60 Minutes and 20/20.
1985年1月20日：President Reagan and Vice President Bush begin their second terms.
1985年：Bernhard Goetz is indicted in New York on charges of attempted murder after shooting four young men who he claimed were intent on mugging him.
1985年：Professional wrestling hits the mainstream with the World Wrestling Federation's WrestleMania I and Saturday Night's Main Event I. The WWF's flagship star, Hulk Hogan, becomes a cultural icon.

1985年：World awareness of famine in Third World countries spark "We Are the World" and Live Aid. Also, awareness of AIDS (acquired immune deficiency syndrome) is raised with the death of actor Rock Hudson.
1985年：Country music singer Willie Nelson and John Mellencamp organize the first Farm Aid concert to raise money for family farmers facing financial crisis.
1985年：The Ford Taurus and Mercury Sable (as 1986 models), and the Nintendo Entertainment System are released to the public.
1985年：Gramm Rudman Hollings Balanced Budget Act
links: Gramm Rudman Hollings Balanced Budget Act

items.text: 1986年：Iran–Contra affair breaks
1986年：The Space Shuttle Challenger explodes 73 seconds after liftoff, killing all seven aboard (including school teacher Christa McAuliffe) and grounding the nation's space program for 21⁄2 years.
1986年：The Firearm Owners Protection Act is signed into law by President Reagan.
1986年：Tax Reform Act of 1986
1986年：The Marshall Islands become independent from the United States.
1986年：The Fox Broadcasting Company launched, becoming the first "fourth major network" since DuMont to offer nightly programming.
1987年：Assorted scandals involve popular televangelists, including Jim Bakker, Oral Roberts, and Jimmy Swaggart.
1987年：During a visit to Berlin, Germany, President Reagan challenges Soviet General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev to "Tear down this wall!" (referring to the Berlin Wall).
links: General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1987年：The Dow Jones Industrial Average falls 22.6% in a single session on Black Monday.

1987年11月22日：An unidentified man wearing the Max Headroom mask appears out of nowhere on television stations WGN-TV and WTTW in Chicago. It is to this day the most notorious television broadcast interruption. As of 2026, the mystery is still unsolved, However, many people on Reddit claim they were behind the crime.
1987年：Dennis Conner, on board the challenger boat Stars & Stripes, returns the America's Cup to America.
1987年：The Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty is signed in Washington, D.C. by President Reagan and Soviet Premier Gorbachev.
1988年：Drunk driving awareness is raised after a drunk driver's car crashes into a church bus near Carrollton, Kentucky, killing 27.
1988年：Severe droughts and massive heat wave gripping the Midwest and Rocky Mountain states. The crisis reaches its peak with the Yellowstone fires of 1988.
1988年：Wrigley Field in Chicago, Illinois, becomes the last Major League Baseball park to add lights for night games.
1988年：Discovery is launched as first post-Challenger Space Shuttle flight.
1988年：1988 United States presidential election: George H. W. Bush is elected president, Dan Quayle vice president.
1988年：The Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty goes into effect.
1989年1月20日：Bush becomes the 41st president, Quayle becomes the 44th vice president.
1989年：Time Inc. and Warner Communications announce plans for a merger, forming Time Warner.
1989年：The tanker Exxon Valdez oil spill in Alaska's Prince William Sound, dumping 10.8 million US gallons of oil into pristine wildlife habitat.
1989年：Awareness of stalking is raised with the murder of actress Rebecca Schaeffer by an obsessed fan.
1989年：Hurricane Hugo strikes the Caribbean and U.S. Southeast Coast, causing $7 billion in damage.
1989年：The 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake kills 63 in the greater San Francisco Bay Area. The quake occurs in the midst of Game 3 of the 1989 World Series, caught live on television broadcasts by ABC.
1989年：President Bush declares a "War on Drugs."
1989年：The animated television sitcom The Simpsons debuts on Fox.

1989年：President Bush and Soviet Premier Gorbachev release statements indicating that the Cold War between their nations may be coming to an end. Symbolic elsewhere around the world was the fall of the Berlin Wall in Germany.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1990–2009)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1990–2009)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1990–2009)

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1991年：The Gulf War is waged in the Middle East, by a U.N.-authorized coalition force from thirty-four nations, led by the U.S. and United Kingdom, against Iraq.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1991年：The World Wide Web first debuts as an Internet service.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1991年：The Cold War ends as the USSR is dissolved. The United States becomes the only superpower in the world.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：Los Angeles riots result in over 60 deaths and $1 billion in damage, spurred by the acquittal of four Los Angeles Police Department officers accused in the videotaped beating of black motorist Rodney King.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：Hurricane Andrew, a Category 5 hurricane, kills 65 people and causes $26 billion in damage to Florida and other areas of the U.S. Gulf Coast, and will be the costliest natural disaster until Hurricane Katrina in 2005.
links: Gulf Coast of the United States

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：Hurricane Iniki is the strongest hurricane ever to hit Hawaii.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：1992 United States presidential election: Bill Clinton elected president; Al Gore elected vice president.
1993年1月20日：Clinton becomes the 42nd president; Gore becomes the 45th vice president.
1993年：A truck bomb explodes in the parking garage under the World Trade Center in New York City, killing six people and injuring over a thousand.
1993年：Branch Davidians standoff and fire near Waco, Texas, resulting in the deaths of 81 people including their leader, David Koresh.
1993年：The "Storm of the Century" strikes the Eastern Seaboard, with blizzard conditions and severe weather, killing 300 people and causing $6 billion in damage.
1993年：Massive flooding along the Mississippi and Missouri Rivers kill 50 people and devastate the Midwest with $15–$20 billion in damage.
1993年：President Clinton signs 'Don't ask, don't tell' into law which prohibits gay or bisexual people from serving openly in the military.
1994年：North American Free Trade Agreement goes in effect.
1994年：1994 Northridge earthquake kills 72 and injures 9,000 in the Los Angeles area and causes $20 billion in damage.
1994年：Former Arkansas state employee Paula Jones accuses President Clinton of sexual harassment.
1994年：The United States hosts the FIFA World Cup, which is won by Brazil.

1995年：Retired professional football player O. J. Simpson is acquitted of two charges of first-degree murder in the 1994 slayings of his ex-wife, Nicole Brown Simpson, and Ronald Goldman. The nine-month trial receives worldwide publicity.
1995年：A heat wave kills 739 in Chicago, bringing to attention the plight of the urban poor and the elderly in extreme weather conditions.
1995年－1996年：A budget crisis forces the federal government to shut down for several weeks.
1996年：TWA Flight 800 explodes off Long Island killing all 230 aboard.
1996年：Khobar Towers bombing leaves 19 U.S. servicemen dead in Saudi Arabia.
1996年：Centennial Olympic Park bombing at Summer Olympics in Atlanta kills 1 and injures 111.
1996年：1996 United States presidential election: Bill Clinton is re-elected president, Al Gore is re-elected vice president.
1997年1月20日：President Clinton and Vice President Gore begin their second terms.
1997年：Sparked by a global economic crisis scare, the Dow Jones Industrial Average follows world markets and plummets 554.26, or 7.18%, to 7,161.15.
1998年：In the 1998 United States elections, the Republicans hold both the House and the Senate.

1998年－1999年：Clinton–Lewinsky scandal: President Clinton is accused of having a sexual relationship with 22-year-old White House intern Monica Lewinsky. This leads to the impeachment of Clinton later in the year by the U.S. House of Representatives. Clinton is acquitted of all impeachment charges of perjury and obstruction of justice in a 21-day Senate trial.
1999年：The Dow Jones Industrial Average closes above the 10,000 mark for the first time, at 10,006.78.
1999年：Teenage students Eric Harris and Dylan Klebold murder 12 other students and one teacher at Columbine High School, sparking an international debate on gun control and bullying.
1999年：A violent tornado outbreak in Oklahoma kills 50 people, becoming the first one to produce $1 billion in damage.
1999年：The first officer deliberately crashes EgyptAir Flight 990 south of Nantucket, Massachusetts, killing 217.

1999年：Along with the rest of the world, the U.S. prepares for the possible effects of the Y2K bug in computers, which was feared to cause computers to become inoperable and wreak havoc. The problem isn't as large as theorized, preparations are successful, and disaster is averted.
2000年：The Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, the USS Cole (DDG-67) is bombed in Yemeni waters, killing seventeen U.S. Navy sailors.

2000年：2000 United States presidential election: Initial result inconclusive and the result in Florida is disputed. George W. Bush is certified president after a Supreme Court ruling. Al Gore wins the nationwide popular vote but loses the electoral college. Dick Cheney is certified vice president.
2001年1月20日：Bush becomes the 43rd president; Cheney becomes the 46th vice president.
2001年：Democrats gain narrow control of Senate after Jim Jeffords defects from the Republican Party.
2001年：No Child Left Behind Act education reform bill passed.
2001年：Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2001 institutes large tax cuts.
links: Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2001

items.text: 2001年：Congress passes an emergency bailout package for the airline industry as a result of the attacks
2001年：Anthrax attacks kill 5 and infect a further 17 through the U.S. Mail system.
2001年：The United States launches the invasion of Afghanistan marking the start of Operation Enduring Freedom.
2001年：Patriot Act, increasing law enforcement agencies' ability to conduct searches in cases of suspected terrorism. Agencies were enforced.
2001年：American Airlines Flight 587 crashes in Queens, New York, killing 265.
2002年：The Department of Homeland Security is created in the wake of the September 11 attacks.
links: United States Department of Homeland Security

items.text: 2002年：The United States withdraws from Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty.
2002年：10 people are killed and 3 are injured in the Beltway sniper attacks around the Washington D.C. area.
2003年：Republicans retake narrow control of the Senate following 2002 elections.
2003年：Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrates upon re-entry to the Earth's atmosphere, killing all seven astronauts and resulting in a 29-month suspension of the Space Shuttle program.

2003年：A series of incidents occur that institute a crackdown on building, fire, and safety code violations across the United States, including the E2 nightclub stampede which killed 21, The Station nightclub fire which killed 100, and a porch collapse which killed 13.
2003年：U.S. forces continue fighting an insurgency in Iraq while helping the Iraqis build a new army of their own and develop a democratic form of government
2003年：In Iraq, deposed Iraqi president Saddam Hussein is captured by U.S. special forces.
2004年：The social networking website Facebook is launched.

2004年：The 2004 Atlantic hurricane season produces four deadly and damaging hurricanes which impact Florida, Charley, Frances, Ivan, and Jeanne, which kill a combined 100 people in the U.S. and produce over $50 billion in damage
2004年：Massachusetts becomes the first state to legalize same-sex marriage in compliance with a ruling from the state's Supreme Court ruling in Goodridge v. Department of Public Health
links: Same-sex marriage in the United States
Goodridge v. Department of Public Health

items.text: 2004年：Former President Ronald Reagan dies from complications resulting from Alzheimer's disease. He lies in state at the U.S. Capitol building before being interred.
links: Death and state funeral of Ronald Reagan

items.text: 2004年：2004 United States presidential election: George W. Bush is re-elected president, Dick Cheney is re-elected vice president.
2005年1月20日：President Bush and Vice President Cheney begin their second terms.
2006年：The Democratic Party retakes control of both houses of Congress, and gains a majority of state governorships (28-22).
2007年：Democrat Nancy Pelosi becomes the first female speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
links: Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives

items.text: 2007年：George W. Bush orders a troop surge which substantially increases the number of U.S. troops in Iraq and ultimately leads to reductions in casualties and major victories for coalition and Iraqi forces, against the insurgency.

2007年：A South Korean student shoots and kills 32 other students and professors in the Virginia Tech shooting before killing himself. It stands as the worst mass shooting in U.S. history until 2016 and spurs a series of debates on gun control and journalism ethics.
2007年：The first iPhone is released for sale in the U.S.

2007年：The I-35W Mississippi River bridge in Minneapolis, Minnesota collapses, killing 13 people. The bridge collapse brings to national attention the need to rehabilitate the aging U.S. infrastructure system.
2007年：The Great Recession officially begins in December.
links: Great Recession in the United States

items.text: 2008年：The Super Tuesday tornado outbreak kills over 60 people and produces $1 billion in damage across Arkansas, Kentucky, Tennessee, and Alabama.

2008年：Steven Kazmierczak kills five, injures 21, and then kills himself in the Northern Illinois University shooting. After this incident, calls are made for more focus on mental health services and interest grows substantially in the group Students for Concealed Carry on Campus.
links: Students for Concealed Carry on Campus

items.text: 2008年：Hurricane Ike kills 100 people along the Texas coast, produces $31 billion in damage, and contributes to rising oil prices.
2008年：U.S. oil prices hit a record $147 per barrel in the wake of—among other factors—international tensions and the falling U.S. dollar vs. the Euro.

2008年：The 2008 financial crisis begins as the stock market crashes. In response, U.S. President George W. Bush signs the revised Emergency Economic Stabilization Act into law to create a 700 billion dollar Treasury fund to purchase failing bank assets.
links: United States Emergency Economic Stabilization fund

items.text: 2008年：2008 United States presidential election: Barack Obama is elected president, and Joe Biden elected vice president.
2009年1月20日：Obama becomes the 44th president, Biden becomes the 47th vice president. Obama is the first African-American to hold the office.

2009年：The first of a series of Tea Party protests are conducted across the United States, focusing on smaller government, fiscal responsibility, individual freedoms and conservative views of the Constitution.
2009年：President Obama obtains Congressional approval for the $787 billion stimulus package, the largest since President Dwight D. Eisenhower.
links: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009

items.text: 2009年：Pop icon Michael Jackson dies, creating the largest public mourning for an entertainer since the death of Elvis Presley.
2009年：Nidal Hasan kills 12 servicemen and injures 31 in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (2010–present)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (2010–present)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (2010–present)

items.text: 2010年：The Deepwater Horizon oil rig in the Gulf of Mexico explodes, spilling millions of gallons of oil into the sea. The spill becomes the worst oil spill in American history.
2010年：In the 2010 Midterm elections, the Republicans retake the House of Representatives as the Democrats lose 63 seats.
links: United States House of Representatives elections, 2010

items.text: 2011年：Representative Gabrielle Giffords is severely wounded in an assassination attempt when a gunman went on a shooting spree, killing federal judge John Roll and five other people, and wounding at least 13 others, at an event Giffords was hosting in suburban Tucson, Arizona.
2011年：The ATF gunwalking scandal emerged, wherein thousands of guns were allowed to "walk" through interdiction to Mexico, supposedly to aid in the capture of criminals.
2011年：A series of tornadoes cause heavy damage in the South, Alabama being the hardest hit. 324 people are killed in the deadliest American natural disaster since Hurricane Katrina.
2011年：Osama bin Laden, leader of al-Qaeda and mastermind of the September 11 attacks, is killed in Abbottabad, Pakistan, by U.S. Navy SEALs.
2011年：Flooding devastates the Mississippi River valley causing $2 to $4 billion in damage.
2011年：A tornado devastates Joplin, Missouri, killing 158 and injuring over 1,000, making it the deadliest single U.S. tornado since the advent of modern weather forecasting
